summary: Post-import reconciliation: in the `automation-gateway` container run `aap-gateway-manage migrate` and in `shell_plus` delete `HTTPPort`, `ServiceNode` and `ServiceCluster` objects; move `extra_settings` to `component_extra_settings`; remove `resource_server` Podman secrets; rerun the installer; run `aap-eda-manage resource_sync` in `automation-eda-api` if EDA is present; and list instances with `awx-manage list_instances`.
questions: How do I reset platform gateway service config after migration?
Remove resource server secrets in containerized AAP
Steps after importing a migration into containerized AAP

answer_card.title: Reconcile containerized target
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
podman exec -it automation-gateway bash
aap-gateway-manage migrate
aap-gateway-manage shell_plus
>>> HTTPPort.objects.all().delete(); ServiceNode.objects.all().delete(); ServiceCluster.objects.all().delete()

for i in `podman secret ls | egrep 'resource_server' | awk '{print $2}'`; do podman secret rm $i; done
# rerun the installer with the same inventory
podman exec -it automation-eda-api aap-eda-manage resource_sync   # if EDA
podman exec -it automation-controller-task awx-manage list_instances
```
